steps.why: the provider masks keys in the list; its masked chip IS the copy control, and the newest key is first

notes: Signed in already via the robot profile's Google session. Recording replays clean: a second unattended run minted a different key, so it is reusable, not a one-off. PROVEN 2026-08-23 upstream (GET api.reka.ai/v1/models -> 200, POST /v1/chat/completions on reka-flash-3 -> 200 with real text) AND through OmniRoute (reka/reka-flash-3 -> 200, real streamed text). CORRECTION to an earlier note: OmniRoute DOES route reka. /v1/models simply never lists the first-party reka/ prefix, so the model list is not a precondition -- the per-connection endpoint /api/providers/{id}/models is.
